protocol.experiment: HDGM V4 frozen semantically aligned causal perturbation v2

stage_definition.encoding: phase 1 or 3 (Cue A or Cue B)
stage_definition.maintenance: phase 2 or 4 excluding terminal readout window
stage_definition.readout: terminal readout_width samples ending at decision

operation_cut_definition.ec: selected afferent x_mod and EC-controlled memory-write strength are set to zero at the targeted stage
operation_cut_definition.ca3: the associative recurrent term M@h is removed at the targeted stage; the learned gate, local term, and five iterations remain
operation_cut_definition.ca1: the memory-derived term M@g is removed at the targeted stage; the predictive term, learned gain, residual path, and feedback remain

protocol.gate_trial_shuffle_definition: the selected learned gate is cyclically permuted across trials at the same time step, preserving its population distribution while breaking trial alignment
protocol.ca1_predictive_cut_definition: the predictive component 0.5*g is removed at each tested stage, providing a preregistered component-level counterpart to the CA1 memory-derived M@g cut
